title: It broke
text: It broke. My husband is 200lbs and he threw myself ONCE on the bed and the bed frame broke. It lasted about one month. We need to buy a new bed frame. I am disappointed because this frame is suppose to be extremely strong but obvious my husband is stronger.

product_metadata.title: Flex Form Platform Bed Frame-California King, 14 Inch, 63-Pound
features: Eliminates the need for a frame; boxspring or foundation
14 inch frame height allows for ample under bed storage
description: The platform bed frame is provides a unique and inexpensive alternative for bed foundations. The frame eliminates the need for a metal frame and box spring. At 14 inches tall, there is ample underbed storage compared to a 6 inches-8 inches Metal frame. The frame assembles in minutes with no tool required. This durable frame can hold up to 3,500 Lbs. The Fabric free black anodized coated 100percentage steel construction is free fo dust mites and allergens.
